records.summary: The Nushara Bayou is the wet country of channels, reed beds and low hummocks behind the south-east coast between Archon and the Althii islands. The Three Waters Tribe lives on its rafts and stilts, and its back-water routes carry trade past the customs men.
records.landform: A bayou of braided channels, reed flats and low hummocks, open at its south edge to the strait
records.climate: Hot and humid year-round, under a fixed weather of heavy rain and mist

notes.text: The marsh country between Archon, the Althii islands and the mound country, laced by channels and settled by the Three Waters Tribe. It links Archon with the Lilmoth coast by water.

notes.text: The bayou was Lilmothiit and Cantemiric Velothi ground; no Lilmothiit or Velothi lives here after the Knahaten Flu (2E 560-603), while the Three Waters Tribe survived and spread. Its villages lie east of the island path through Murkmire that Umbriel laid waste in 4E 48.

notes.text: The Three Waters Tribe holds the channels and its hamlets, Archon and Lilmoth trade through it, and Fort Swiftmoth beside the road has stood empty since the secession.

notes.text: The people are the Three Waters Argonians. Clay-Mound families live at Badal and Lilmoth-coast families at Oju. Archon's boatmen also work the channels.

notes.text: Rice, fish, reed, shellfish and back-water freight that avoids customs; Archon is the market.

notes.text: Sithis and the Hist, with the town of Uluo keeping the nearest tree for hatching.
Sheets of brown water between reed banks and hummocks of trees, lines of raft-houses and herons.
Risky away from the road: slaughterfish in every deep channel, crocodilians on the hummocks, ripper eels, smugglers and swamp disease.
Flat and braided: channels split and rejoin around thin ridges of firm ground, and the walkable ground is a chain of hummocks joined by raft-bridges. The north climbs slightly to clay mounds.
Reed, mangrove, saltrice, slaughterfish, eels, wading birds and mud-crabs.
Hot and humid all year; the region's fixed weather is heavy warm rain and low mist over the water.

records.summary: The Althii Archipelago is two main low islands and a scatter of islets off the south-east coast, with Lilmoth at the southern end and the Three Waters town of Uluo on the north. Estates, farms and Imperial and Lilmothiit ruins fill the interior.
records.landform: Low islands of firm ground with inner marsh, hills of a few metres and sea-cut coasts
records.climate: Hot and humid, under a fixed weather of sea wind and warm rain

notes.text: A group of islands that holds Lilmoth, the estates of the rebuilt coast, and an Imperial road gone to ruin.

notes.text: The Lilmothiit withdrew inland over generations and the Knahaten Flu (2E 560-603) finished their remnant. The Empire's forts, estates and road came later and were left at the secession (4E 5-10). Lilmoth was destroyed in 4E 48, and the islands were refilled in the generations after.

notes.text: Lilmoth leads the islands; Archwarden forts hold the east and the south-west, some of them against Lilmoth's wishes; Uluo's Three Waters people hold the north.

notes.text: Lilmoth-coast Argonians, tenants and labourers on the estates, garrison families of the Warden forts and the Three Waters Tribe.

notes.text: The islands live on rice, fish, salvage and ferrying; Lilmoth is the market for all of it.

sources.title: Reasoned from the spine: 10.1 (2E 560-603 Flu, 4E 5-10 secession, 4E 8 second Hist, 4E 48 Umbriel); 10.2 (Lilmoth's merchant council, Warden coast forts, Three Waters Tribe); 10.4 (Lilmothiit withdrawal, Imperial forts)

notes.text: Lilmoth's second Hist, grown in 4E 8 and cut off from the others, is the islands' feared tree; the Three Waters keep their own pool.
Green rice paddies, stilt villages and brick ruins in vines, with sea on every side.
Risky in the interior: bandits in the burnt forts, predators in the dens, sea-drakes at the coast.
Low and flat with a few low hills, cut by inlets and inner channels; roads link the towns across land and ferries.
Mangrove coasts, paddy fauna, wading birds, guar and crabs fill the islands.
The islands are hot and humid; the region's fixed weather is a steady sea wind and warm rain.

records.summary: Benthic Yobesh is the open sea floor east of the Althii islands where seven drowned spires, Echo Deep and the downed Kelp Lantern lie. Only Bell Station's divers work it.
records.landform: A sea floor of silt and coral flats with drowned spires and a deep trench
records.biome: Open sea floor, coral and kelp
records.climate: Warm shallow water over cold deep water

notes.text: The sea east of Lilmoth covers drowned ground with spires and a trench.

notes.text: Argonians hold the deep as the abode of the drowned and pray before diving.
Blue-green water over silt, coral and kelp, spires standing from the floor, a black trench.
Dangerous across the floor and deadly at Echo Deep and the outer spires: sea-drakes, dreugh, and deep water where a diver's breath runs out.
A shelf of silt about forty metres down, spires to eight metres below the surface, and a trench.
Kelp, coral, slaughterfish, sea-drakes, dreugh, glowgill guar at the western edge.
Warm shallows over cold deep water; the surface under a fixed grey overcast and a steady swell.
